_comment: Persona matrix for usability testing. Each persona pairs a finance user (asset class, skill level, seniority, goal) with a synthetic model spec. Subagents generate the model (tests/personas/generators/<slug>.mjs) and simulate the journey. All data synthetic.

personas.goal: Turn our LBO model into an explorable web app for LPs.
personas.modelSpec: Mid-market LBO: Assumptions (entry/exit multiple, leverage, growth, margin, pref, carry%), P&L (revenue→EBITDA over 5-6yr), Debt schedule (single balance row, prior-column roll-forward), Returns/IC Summary (entry equity, exit equity, MOIC, IRR, GP carry $). Defined names: ExitMultiple, RevenueGrowth, Leverage.

personas.goal: Build an IC sensitivity tool and hand the engine to our dev.
personas.modelSpec: Minority growth investment in a software co: ARR build (new + expansion - churn) over 6yr, revenue multiple exit, ownership %, primary/secondary. Summary: revenue multiple, exit equity, gross MOIC/IRR. Defined names: RevenueMultiple, ARRGrowth, Ownership.

personas.goal: Give LPs a portal showing fund returns and a power-law what-if.
personas.modelSpec: Seed fund: portfolio of ~10 companies with entry valuations, ownership, exit multiples (power-law), fund-level paid-in, distributed, NAV. Fund metrics: TVPI, DPI, RVPI, net IRR, fund MOIC, GP carry (20% over 1.0x). Defined names: FundSize, CarryRate.

personas.goal: Investor web app with cap-rate and rent-growth sliders.
personas.modelSpec: Value-add multifamily: NOI build (rental income, vacancy, opex) over 7yr, exit on cap rate (use 'Exit Cap Rate' label), acquisition + reno capex, agency debt (LTV, amortization as single balance row). Summary: exit value, equity multiple, leveraged IRR, cash-on-cash. Defined names: ExitCapRate, RentGrowth, LTV.

personas.goal: Long-hold yield/IRR explorer for the investment committee.
personas.modelSpec: Renewables/availability asset, 12-15yr hold: contracted revenue with escalation, opex, EBITDA, project debt (long amortization), distributions/yield per year, terminal/residual value. Summary: project IRR, equity IRR, DSCR, yield. Defined names: Escalation, ExitYield, GearingRatio.

personas.goal: A yield + covenant calculator app for deal screening.
personas.modelSpec: Unitranche loan: principal, spread+base rate, OID, fees, call protection, 5-7yr. Borrower EBITDA path, leverage (Debt/EBITDA), interest coverage (EBITDA/Interest), DSCR. Returns: gross yield/IRR to lender, MOIC. Defined names: Spread, BaseRate, OID.

personas.goal: A budget scenario tool execs can use without Excel.
personas.modelSpec: 3-statement-lite: revenue by segment, gross margin, opex, EBITDA, D&A, EBIT, taxes, net income; simple balance items; free cash flow; DCF with WACC + terminal growth → enterprise value, equity value. Defined names: WACC, TerminalGrowth, RevenueGrowth.

personas.goal: A buyer-returns explorer to include with the CIM.
personas.modelSpec: Sell-side LBO/returns view from a buyer's lens: purchase price (entry multiple), sources & uses, financing (senior+mezz), 5yr projection, exit multiple, sponsor IRR/MOIC, accretion. Defined names: PurchaseMultiple, ExitMultiple, SeniorLeverage.

SaaS metrics: ARR (new bookings, expansion, gross churn), NRR, CAC, magic number, burn, runway, gross margin, Rule of 40, implied valuation at ARR multiple. Monthly→annual ok but use ANNUAL year headers. Defined names: ARRMultiple, NetRetention, NewBookingsGrowth.

personas.goal: An investor-update app showing returns under a few cases.
personas.modelSpec: Single SMB acquisition: purchase (3-5x SDE/EBITDA), SBA + seller note + searcher equity, modest growth, exit 5-7yr, stepped equity (search/acquisition/operation), searcher carry/vesting. Summary: investor MOIC/IRR, searcher equity value. Defined names: EntryMultiple, ExitMultiple, SBALeverage.

personas.goal: A portfolio roll-up dashboard for the principals.
personas.modelSpec: FoF: commitments across ~6 underlying funds, called/uncalled, NAV, distributions, blended TVPI/DPI/net IRR, J-curve over 10yr, management fee + carry overlay. Defined names: TotalCommitment, BlendedCarry.

personas.goal: A debt-amortization + DSCR covenant monitor for lenders.
personas.modelSpec: Stabilized RE portfolio: NOI by property, consolidated NOI, senior debt facilities (balance roll-forward by prior column), interest, amortization, DSCR (NOI/Debt Service), LTV, debt yield over 10yr. Defined names: InterestRate, AmortYears.
